def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i]=values[i] on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.

    Returns the values in the order mode, level, then any other keys in the
    order first given. A repeated key takes its last value and keeps its
    first position.
    """
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    ex settings(keys=[], values=[]) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(keys=["level", "mode"], values=["5", "slow"]) == ["slow", "5"]
    ex settings(keys=["color", "mode"], values=["red", "x"]) == ["x", "3", "red"]
    out: dict[str, str] = {"mode": "fast", "level": "3"}
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        out[keys[i].copy()] = values[i].copy()
    mode = out.get("mode") else "fast"
    level = out.get("level") else "3"
    res: list[str] = [mode, level]
    for k, v in out.items():
        if k == "mode" or k == "level":
            continue
        res.append(v.copy())
    return res
